name: zila-lang
description: Syntax highlighting, syntax errors and formatting for Zila Lang (.br), through the zila-parse language server

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The language server is an executable named by a setting; it is not started from an untrusted workspace's settings.

zila.server.path.markdownDescription: The `zila-parse` executable that runs the language server (`zila-parse --lsp`). A name is looked up on `PATH`.

zila.server.enabled.markdownDescription: Run the language server for syntax errors and formatting. Highlighting works without it.

zila.trace.markdownDescription: Write the messages exchanged with the language server to the **Zila Lang Language Server** output channel.
